description: This header file defines the WebPA Abstraction APIs, including enums, structs, macros, and function prototypes related to WebPA configuration, notification, and communication mechanisms within the WebPA framework.

methods.name: msgBusInit
methods.description: Initializes the Message Bus and registers WebPA component with the stack.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes the request and returns response payload.

methods.name: setInitialNotify
methods.description: Sets the initial Notify parameters from config file.

methods.name: waitForConnectReadyCondition
methods.description: Waits until all components required for connecting to server are initialized.

methods.name: waitForOperationalReadyCondition
methods.description: Waits until all components required for being operational are initialized.

methods.name: _WEBPA_LOG
methods.description: Logs messages using WEBPA RDK logger API.

methods.name: getWebPAConfig
methods.description: Returns the WebPA configuration data for a given parameter.
